questions.stem:
SCIENCE PASSAGE 2: Mulch and Soil Infiltration
Students packed identical soil columns and applied simulated rain. Experiment 1 compared bare soil with 2 cm and 5 cm layers of straw mulch. They measured water collected below each column after 20 minutes. Experiment 2 repeated the treatments after gently compacting the soil.

Which follow-up would most directly strengthen or extend the investigation?
A) Repeat only the result that best matches the original expectation and discard the others.
B) Measure runoff as well as collected water to account for the applied rain more completely.
C) Change every variable at once so that no control condition remains.
D) Stop collecting measurements and infer the answer from the graph title.

options.A: Repeat only the result that best matches the original expectation and discard the others.
options.B: Measure runoff as well as collected water to account for the applied rain more completely.
options.C: Change every variable at once so that no control condition remains.
options.D: Stop collecting measurements and infer the answer from the graph title.

questions.explanation: The proposed follow-up changes or replicates conditions in a way that produces interpretable additional evidence.

questions.stem:
SCIENCE MATERIAL SET 4
Students tested how water temperature affected the time required for a tablet to dissolve. They used identical tablets, 103 mL of water in each cup, and stirred each cup at the same rate.

TABLE 1
Temperature (°C) | Dissolving time (s)
10 | 32
20 | 24
30 | 19
40 | 15

Trial 2 repeated the procedure with twice the water volume. Researcher 1 claims that higher temperature increases particle motion and therefore decreases dissolving time. Researcher 2 agrees that temperature matters but claims that stirring rate is the dominant factor whenever stirring is not controlled.

Researcher 1 claims that higher temperature:
A) eliminates particle motion
B) increases particle motion and shortens dissolving time
C) has no possible effect
D) changes only the cup color

options.B: increases particle motion and shortens dissolving time
options.D: changes only the cup color

questions.explanation: The keyed response follows the material and directly targets 识别研究者的主张、假设或模型.
